errors.text_span: mit 38,1% im Jahr 2014 und 31,1% im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The values for the years 2014 and 2021 have been swapped. According to the chart, the value for "Übrige" was 31.1% in 2014 (inner ring) and 38.1% in 2021 (outer ring).

errors.text_span: "Kombinierte Versorgung" mit 11,9% (hellblau) im Jahr 2014 und 10,2% (dunkelblau) im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: This statement is entirely incorrect. The category "Kombinierte Versorgung" had a value of 6.2% in 2014 and 5.5% in 2021. The values 11.9% (actually 11.8%) and 10.2% belong to "Wasserversorgung" and "Abwasserentsorgung" respectively, both for the year 2014. The color is also wrong; it is light red/pink, not blue.

errors.text_span: "Stromversorgung" mit 8,9% (dunkelgrün) im Jahr 2014 und 8,4% (grün) im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The values are assigned to the wrong years and one is incorrect. "Stromversorgung" was 4.2% in 2014 and 8.9% in 2021. The description states 8.9% for 2014 and an incorrect value of 8.4% for 2021.

errors.text_span: "Abwasserentsorgung" mit 7,8% (hellgrün) im Jahr 2014 und 7,3% (blaugrün) im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The values are assigned to the wrong years and one is incorrect. "Abwasserentsorgung" was 10.2% in 2014 and 7.8% in 2021. The description states 7.8% for 2014 and an incorrect value of 7.3% for 2021.
The color for "Abwasserentsorgung" is light blue, not light green.
The value for "Wohnungswesen" in 2021 is 7.2%, not 7.3%.
The color for "Wohnungswesen" is light green, not blue.

The description lists ten categories ("Wirtschaftsförderung" through "Kombinierte Versorgung") with only a single percentage value for each, without specifying which year (2014 or 2021) the value corresponds to. This omits half of the data for these categories.

errors.text_span: (4,7%, hellgrau), "Verkehr" (3,7%, lila), "Kliniken" (3,2%, orange), "Kultur" (2,2%, dunkelgrau), "Sport/Erholung" (3,6%, türkis), "Abfallwirtschaft"  (3,4%, gelb), "Wasserversorgung" (8,8%, violett), "Gasversorgung" (1,5%, pink), "Übrige Versorgung" (1,3%, braun) und "Kombinierte Versorgung" (6,5%, hellblau/dunkelblau)
errors.evidence: The colors assigned to all ten categories listed here are incorrect. For example, "Wirtschaftsförderung" is light green, not hellgrau; "Verkehr" is grey, not lila; "Kliniken" is light blue, not orange.
The value for "Kombinierte Versorgung" is stated as 6.5%, but the actual values in the chart are 6.2% for 2014 and 5.5% for 2021.

errors.text_span: die Kategorien sind nach ihrer Größe im Jahr 2014 angeordnet
errors.evidence: The categories are not sorted by size. For example, following the largest segment "Übrige" (31.1%), the next segment clockwise is "Kultur" at 2.2%, which is one of the smallest.
